steps.message: In Simple Calendar Pro, create a calendar event for this Thursday at 3h with the title 'Meeting with Dr. Smith' and the description 'We will discuss marketing strategies.'. The event should last for 15 mins.

Execute: adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z (%u)'; pm list packages | grep -i simplemobiletools.calendar; content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/calendars --projection _id:calendar_displayName:calendar_access_level:ownerAccount:account_name:account_type:visible:sync_events"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z (%u)'; pm list packages | grep -i simplemobiletools.calendar; content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/calendars --projection _id:calendar_displayName:calendar_access_level:ownerAccount:account_name:account_type:visible:sync_events""
